https://example-labs.example/x400.text: The Example Labs X400 network card has two 100GbE ports and uses a PCIe 4.0 x4 slot in its low-profile model. Example Labs lists the X400 at $649 new. Used cards sold for between $180 and $240 on auction sites in September 2026. The driver is in the mainline Linux kernel since version 6.8, and the card works with the standard ethtool utilities. At PCIe 4.0 x4 the slot limits throughput to about 63 Gbit/s, below the port's 100 Gbit/s line rate. https://news.example/2026/03/x500.title: Example Labs announces X500
https://news.example/2026/03/x500.text: On 14 March 2026 Example Labs announced the X500, a successor with PCIe 5.0 x8. The company said the X400 stays on sale through 2027. Reviewers measured 58 Gbit/s on the X400 in a PCIe 4.0 x4 slot with jumbo frames. The X500 costs $1,199 at launch according to the announcement.
